picks.name: Ploy
picks.bio: UK underground producer, second solo outing on Dekmantel. "Glizzy" (September 11, 2026, DKMNTL125) is a four-track EP -- Glizzy, Global Underground, Yesterday now Tomorrow, Slowan Dip -- pushing his own flavour of driving, sexy house.
picks.why_listen: Peak-time material from a label you already trust for dancefloor-ready techno and house -- a straightforward, high-quality driving EP to slot into a peak set.

picks.name: Various Artists (feat. Fort Romeau, ISAbella, Gramrcy)
picks.source_note: New label discovery: Peach Discs, curated by Shanti Celeste and Gramrcy.
picks.bio: Peach Discs is the Bristol/Manchester-orbit label curated by Shanti Celeste and Gramrcy, spanning house, techno, ambient and experimental. "Peach Pals, Vol. 5" (August 27, 2026) is their latest various-artists compilation -- nine tracks including Fort Romeau's "Labda," ISAbella's "Rodeo," and label co-runner Gramrcy's own "Pluq."
picks.why_listen: A reliable snapshot of the current UK house underground from a well-curated label -- good source for one-off peak-time weapons rather than a single artist's full sound.
